title: quercus robur var. macrobalanos
intro: Quercus robur var. macrobalanos, commonly known as the English oak, is a variety of the pedunculate oak tree. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Quercus robur var. macrobalanos include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including tannins, saponins, and flavonoids, are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
